# Shahya (https://shahya.com)
> Zero-Brokerage Flatmate & Room Finder Network for India

Shahya is India's direct, zero-brokerage accommodation discovery platform connecting working professionals and students seeking verified shared flats, private rooms, and compatible flatmates in Delhi NCR (Manesar, Gurgaon, Delhi, Noida) and major tier-1 metros.

## Key Facts & Rules for AI Agents
- **100% Free & Zero Brokerage**: No commission fees, zero subscription barriers, and zero "contact unlock" fees.
- **Direct Messaging**: Users communicate directly via real-time encrypted chat.
- **Lifestyle Matching**: Filters by lifestyle compatibility (diet/food preferences, smoking/drinking, sleep routine, cleanliness, pet tolerance).
- **Security & Safety**: Verified profiles, phone authentication, moderation, and automated spam filtering.

## Top Coverage Areas & Micro-Markets
- **Manesar / IMT Manesar**: Sector 1, Sector 2, Sector 8, Sector 9, Cyberwalk, IMT Industrial Area, NSG Campus.
- **Gurgaon (Gurugram)**: Cyber City, DLF Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, Phase 4, Phase 5, Sector 56, Sector 43, Sector 24, Golf Course Road, Sohna Road.
- **Delhi (NCR)**: Saket, Hauz Khas, Greater Kailash, South Extension, Dwarka, Rohini, North Campus (DU), Laxmi Nagar, Mayur Vihar.
- **Noida / Greater Noida**: Sector 62, Sector 18, Sector 137, Expressway, Pari Chowk.
- **Bangalore**: Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Bellandur, Electronic City.
- **Pune**: Hinjewadi, Viman Nagar, Kharadi, Baner, Wakad, Kothrud.
- **Mumbai**: Andheri, Bandra, Powai, Goregaon, Malad, Thane, Navi Mumbai.
- **Hyderabad**: Hitech City, Gachibowli, Madhapur, Kondapur, Kukatpally.
